lessons.claim: Re-running the trap-drag v-sweep as 7 velocities x 9 seeds = 63 runs overturned two of the published conclusions. ① The defect count is not independent of v -- it peaks at 9.43 at gv=24.2 and falls to 6.8~7.0 at both ends (2.42, 1549), a non-monotonic bump (max-min = 5.2 ensemble SEMs). 'There is no critical velocity' holds but 'independent of v' was wrong. ② The monotonic increase of the recovery rate to 67% was also wrong -- that is one realization's value, and the ensemble mean peaks at 36% at gv=72.6 and then decreases (non-monotonic). What held: a yield force of 34~41 kT/d (though the significance goes 11~20σ → 9.5~12.6σ) and shear thinning 16.8→1.84. The cause is a single run per velocity + an underestimated block SEM.
